figures.public_caption: Figure 1a shows photoluminescence (PL) spectra of CdSe quantum dots (QDs) with 1.5 monolayer coverage at different temperatures. Panel 1b displays the temperature-dependent shift in PL peak energy, and panel 1c shows the temperature dependence of PL lifetime, including data for QDs with 1.0 and 3.0 monolayer CdSe coverage.

general_background.title: Arrival and motion at a growth surface
general_background.summary: In molecular beam epitaxy, incident species reach a surface where adsorption, surface motion and incorporation compete. A species that remains on the surface long enough can migrate to a growth site, while desorption competes with incorporation.
